==============================================================
  fs25vr - VR for Farming Simulator 25          HOW TO INSTALL
==============================================================
Unofficial mod - not made by or affiliated with GIANTS Software.
Free and open source: https://github.com/nick10180/FS25VR

LINUX (Steam + Proton): see the "Linux (Proton)" section in README.md,
  or run  bash install.sh  in this folder.

WHAT YOU NEED
  - Farming Simulator 25 on a Windows PC, or the Steam version under
    Proton on Linux (see LINUX above)
  - A PC VR headset (Valve Index, Vive, Quest via Link/Air Link or
    Virtual Desktop, Pico, Windows Mixed Reality ...)
  - SteamVR (or your headset's own PC software) set as the
    "OpenXR runtime". In SteamVR: Settings > OpenXR > "Set SteamVR
    as OpenXR runtime".

INSTALL (2 minutes)
  1. Close the game.
  2. Double-click  INSTALL.bat
     - If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click
       "More info" and then "Run anyway".
     - If it can't find the game, it asks you for the game folder.
       Paste it in (e.g.  D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Farming Simulator 25)
       and press Enter.
     - Xbox app / Microsoft Store version: the game folder is the
       "Content" folder of the install (e.g.
       C:\XboxGames\Farming Simulator 25 (PC)\Content). Its mods
       folder is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\
       GIANTSSoftware.FarmingSimulator25PC_<id>\LocalCache\Local\mods
  3. Start SteamVR (or Quest Link / Virtual Desktop) with your
     headset connected, then start the game.
  4. Load your savegame. In the mod list, make sure
     "VR (OpenXR, stereoscopic 6DOF)" is ticked.
  5. You should see "VR active". Press F8 to recentre your view.
  6. The first time only: the mod measures the picture size your
     headset needs and asks you to restart the game once. After
     that every VR start is sharp, with nothing to set up.
     (Less sharp but faster: lower the resolution in SteamVR.)

IN THE GAME'S GRAPHICS OPTIONS, PLEASE TURN OFF
  - Frame generation (FSR 3 frame generation)
  - DLSS / DSR
  - Motion blur
  These cause doubled or blurry images in VR.

KEYS
  F8   Recentre the view (sit or stand normally first)
  F9   VR camera on / off
  F10  Show / hide the HUD in VR (hidden by default)
       Shift / Ctrl / Alt + F10: HUD size / height / depth
  F5   Foveated rendering on / off
  F6   Projection mode (leave on "centred" unless told otherwise)
  F7   Ambient occlusion mode
  All of these are also in the game: Esc > Settings, section
  "Virtual reality (FS25_VR)".

MENUS, MAP AND SHOP
  These appear on a big flat screen in front of you. Use the mouse
  as normal - a pointer is shown in the headset.

PLAY WITHOUT VR (monitor, TV, projector)
  Nothing to do: if no headset is ready when the game starts (SteamVR
  not running, Quest not connected), the game starts normally with
  your own display settings.

UNINSTALL
  Double-click  UNINSTALL.bat  (or delete dinput8.dll,
  openxr_loader.dll and fs25vr.ini from the game's x64 folder).

SOMETHING WRONG?
  - The mod shows in the list but it stays flat and F8/F9/F10 do
    nothing: Windows has blocked the DLLs. In the game's x64 folder,
    right-click dinput8.dll > Properties > tick "Unblock" > OK.
    Do the same for openxr_loader.dll. (INSTALL.bat normally does
    this for you.)
  - Everything is a flat screen: the VR mod isn't ticked for that
    savegame, or you're in a menu.
  - The game started flat although you wanted VR: start SteamVR
    (and connect the headset) before the game, then restart it.
  - Stutters: lower the game's graphics settings. VR needs a high
    frame rate (ideally above your headset's refresh rate).
  - Send the file  <game folder>\x64\fs25vr.log  with your bug
    report: https://github.com/nick10180/FS25VR/issues
